mentions.name: belgie
mentions.description: This tool makes it easy for AI agents to dynamically generate user interfaces and code in a sandboxed environment. It can create React MCP UIs (and traditional Web UIs) from Python without needing a JS runtime installed, and provides a Deno-backed TypeScript sandbox for agent-generated code via pydantic-ai / langchain. A showcase use case is automatically generating UIs for SQL query results.
mentions.problem: Agents lack an easy, sandboxed way to dynamically generate user interfaces and code, and doing so typically requires a JS runtime to be installed.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been building belgie (https://github.com/mplemay/belgie) with the goal of making it easy for agents to dynamically generate user interfaces / code in a sandboxed environment.
